author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
1.(TheGodTool) Spanky Spade: Really? First it was knockback 2 and 7 points. But now KB1 for 30 points? This needs to be changed immediately. 

2. Monument Points. Used to be 10, and now 1? Amazing! This should be fixed. Including when it takes a while to get a specific defended monument: Reward 7 exp and 1 POINT. No. Just No.

3. Block lag/lag/ncp: This has been the worst of them all. U can barely play with it. One second ur bridging. The next is u falling into the void. Fix plez

4. NEBULA SHOP: Really? Fire resistance? I bet that will be really useful for... Oh wait. Barely any maps have fire/lava. Most useful item ever. Flaming torch? Really? Snowballs? Wow... Why not adding 1 stack of wood? Jukebox and music discs. I don't see any point.

5. Prestige leveling: Whenever u prestige ur level gets resented but u would think "I've gotten to lvl 50 so I can buy everything in the nebula shop". NOPEEEE. Anyone else get bugged with this?



I will add more soon. :>
